reviews.title: No 4 pin PC Speaker header
reviews.comment: Had no issues with the motherboard posting with Crucial 32GB RAM Kit. I'm disappointed in the lack of a PC speaker connection for diagnostic beep codes. This is essential for diagnosing issues like no display. They give you plenty of stickers but I would rather have the 4 pin speaker header. Minor issue is it doesn't support NVME RAID but does support SATA RAID.
reviews.author: Chris A

reviews.title: Lack of RAM compatibility
reviews.comment: Picky about Ram. Tried a few affordable Ram kits. Even ones on the QVL. Still wouldn’t post. Borrowed a friend’s high end G-Skill kit. Booted right up. Very disappointed. Switching to an AMD AM5 build.
reviews.author: Nick Gilmer
